0022600205.text: The Wizards (4-6, 2-4 on the road) come into their 11th game of the 2026-27 season on a three-game losing streak, sitting 2nd in the Southeast and 8th in the East, while the Pistons (6-2) are 1st in the Central and 3rd in the East after a loss in their most recent game. Washington is without Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), and Deandre Ayton is day-to-day with a leg injury, while Detroit is missing Isaiah Joe (hip bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Wizards lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 117-95 loss in Washington on March 19, 2026.
